answer_1.quote: We propose a unified framework to generate both homographic and heterographic puns... the task of context-situated pun generation as: Given a context C ... generate a pun using the chosen pun pair situated in the given context.

answer_2.quote: We report pun word incorporation rate as the automatic evaluation metric to measure the model's ability to incorporate pun words in the final generation.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk to judge whether the generated puns are successful.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters were asked to judge if the generated pun is successful (i.e., humorous and appropriate).
